climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A rosé from the three villages of Les Riceys in the Aube, in Champagne, made only from Pinot Noir. It can be tank-fermented for early drinking or wood-fermented for ageing, and has a distinctive taste the French call goût des Riceys.
